
Bug #39 - Greedy parens in pretty output

Bug in SourceForge.net

from original email requirements:
There is more to consider: 
1----extra parentheses in a QUERY expression.
2----extra parentheses around a local rule
3----how much of this is already embedded in the session model in eengine for an expression.
====

1----extra parentheses in a QUERY expression.
from p11:
query_expression = QUERY ’(’ variable_id ’<*’ aggregate_source ’|’ logical_expression ’)’
what we see:
QUERY ( sf <* stratum_feature_implementation | (TRUE ) )
what we want:
QUERY ( sf <* stratum_feature_implementation | TRUE )

See the code for WR1 in these three cases.

The extra () added after the pipe character in the QUERY causes the
eengine compare to issue lots of noise.

No idea if this is something simple to address as there are cases
where the construct "|(" is needed as in the logical express is two ()
separated by an OR.

i.e., removing the parentheses shall result in a valid logical expression.

This
wr1: ( SIZEOF( QUERY ( sf < stratum_feature_implementation | (TRUE ) ) ) = 0 );
becomes this
WR1: (SIZEOF(QUERY(sf < stratum_feature_implementation | TRUE )) = 0);

But in more complex cases, it may be expensive to detect that right parenthesis.

I suppose as long as we can collapse the argument of the QUERY we can
detect the right parenthesis.

I suppose we could back up to the "(" AFTER THE QUERY SYMBOL and then
move forward to the matching parenthesis. which let's label
'parenthesis_the_ultimate'.

let's label the parenthesis just after the pipe character 'parenthesis_the_initial'.

IF 'parenthesis_the_initial' is matched to the parenthesis just prior
to 'parenthesis_the_ultimate' then that pair of parentheses is
redundant and my be removed.

2---extra parentheses around a local rule
this:
wr1: ( SIZEOF( QUERY ( sf < stratum_feature_implementation | (TRUE ) ) ) = 0 );
should be
wr1: SIZEOF( QUERY ( sf < stratum_feature_implementation | (TRUE ) ) ) = 0 ;

---This is easy(er).
=====data:

source in a module:
ENTITY Additive_laminate_text_component
SUBTYPE OF (Generic_laminate_text_component);
stratum_feature_implementation : SET [1:?] OF Stratum_feature;
WHERE
WR1: SIZEOF(QUERY(sf <* stratum_feature_implementation | sf.associated_definition :<>: stratum_feature_implementation[1].associated_definition)) = 0;
END_ENTITY;

results of old shtolo and stepcode exppp:
ENTITY Additive_laminate_text_component
SUBTYPE OF ( Generic_laminate_text_component );
stratum_feature_implementation : SET [1 : ?] OF Stratum_feature;
WHERE
wr1: ( SIZEOF( QUERY ( sf <* stratum_feature_implementation | ( sf.resident_stratum :<>: stratum_feature_implementation[1].
resident_stratum ) ) ) = 0 );
END_ENTITY;

results of new shtolo:
ENTITY Additive_laminate_text_component
SUBTYPE OF (Generic_laminate_text_component);
stratum_feature_implementation : SET [1:?] OF Stratum_feature;
WHERE
WR1: SIZEOF(QUERY(sf <* stratum_feature_implementation | sf.resident_stratum :<>: stratum_feature_implementation[1].resident_stratum)) = 0;
END_ENTITY;
